SELECT CASE 
  WHEN LOWER(subject) LIKE '%bill%' OR LOWER(body) LIKE '%bill%' OR LOWER(subject) LIKE '%invoice%' OR LOWER(body) LIKE '%invoice%' OR LOWER(subject) LIKE '%price%' OR LOWER(body) LIKE '%price%' THEN 'Billing'
  WHEN LOWER(subject) LIKE '%login%' OR LOWER(body) LIKE '%login%' OR LOWER(subject) LIKE '%password%' OR LOWER(body) LIKE '%password%' OR LOWER(subject) LIKE '%2fa%' OR LOWER(body) LIKE '%2fa%' OR LOWER(subject) LIKE '%locked%' OR LOWER(body) LIKE '%locked%' OR LOWER(subject) LIKE '%sso%' OR LOWER(body) LIKE '%sso%' THEN 'Login'
  WHEN LOWER(subject) LIKE '%parcel%' OR LOWER(body) LIKE '%parcel%' OR LOWER(subject) LIKE '%delivery%' OR LOWER(body) LIKE '%delivery%' THEN 'Delivery'
  ELSE 'Other' END AS theme,
  COUNT(*) AS cnt
FROM workspace.exam_x225a4.tickets
GROUP BY theme
ORDER BY cnt DESC;
